data.name: Account.Page.Failed
data.value: This could not be read. The server did not answer, or answered with an error.

data.name: Account.Page.NotAUser
data.value: Only a user has this. The account you signed in with is a key or a service account.
data.comment: Shown for the 403 of the two-factor, logins and preferences routes.

data.name: Account.Sessions.Explained
data.value: Each row is one sign-in of an app with your account. Ending one stops that app's sign-in at its next request. It does not sign the browser out of the sign-in server, so an app that browser opens again signs in again; to end that too, sign out from the user menu in that browser. If you end the sign-in of this tab, the admin signs in again on its own.
data.comment: What ending a session does and does not end.

data.name: Account.Sessions.Started
data.comment: {0} is the date and time of the sign-in.

data.name: Account.Sessions.EndWhich
data.comment: Read after End by assistive technology only; {0} is the app.

data.name: Account.Sessions.EndFailed
data.value: The session could not be ended. Try again.

data.name: Account.Sessions.ThisTabEnded
data.value: The sign-in of this tab has ended. The admin signs in again.

data.name: Account.Consents.Explained
data.value: These MCP clients count toward the number of clients one account may keep, also one whose consent no longer holds. Ending your consent stops the client's access with your account at once and frees its place; it asks for your consent again if it signs in once more.
data.comment: What the list is and what ending a consent does.

data.name: Account.Consents.Active
data.comment: {0} is the date and time of the consent.

data.name: Account.Consents.Inactive
data.value: Your consent no longer holds, given {0}; the client still counts
data.comment: {0} is the date and time of the consent, which its session or a change of password has ended.

data.name: Account.Consents.InactiveUndated
data.value: No consent of yours holds; the client still counts

data.name: Account.Consents.EndWhich
data.comment: Read after End consent by assistive technology only; {0} is the client.

data.name: Account.Consents.EndWhichGiven
data.comment: Read after End consent by assistive technology only; {0} is the client, {1} the date and time of the consent.

data.name: Account.Consents.ConfirmText
data.value: {0} loses its access with your account at once: its tokens are refused from their next request. Its place among your clients is free again.

data.name: Account.Consents.Gone
data.value: {0} no longer counts toward your clients: it was removed, or your consent was ended already.

data.name: Account.Consents.Changed
data.value: {0} changed at the same moment, so its place was not freed. End the consent again.

data.name: Account.Consents.Busy
data.value: Other consents are being changed, so nothing was ended. Try again in a moment.

data.name: Account.Consents.EndFailed
data.value: The consent could not be ended. Try again.

data.value: Two-factor sign-in is off. With it on, signing in also asks for a code from an authenticator app.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.On
data.value: Two-factor sign-in is on. Recovery codes left: {0}.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.Required
data.value: A role of yours requires it: the next sign-in asks you to set it up.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.Pending
data.value: A setup was started and not finished. Setting it up again gives a new key.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.ScanHeading
data.value: Add your account to an authenticator app

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.ScanText
data.value: Scan the QR code with the app, then enter the code it shows.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.QrLabel
data.value: QR code for the authenticator app. The key beside it holds the same.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.KeyText
data.value: Or enter this key in the app:

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.CodeOrRecovery
data.value: Code from the app, or a recovery code

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.WrongCode
data.value: The code is not right, or your account is locked out for a while. Check that the clock of the device is right, or wait for the next code.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.SignInAgainFirst
data.value: Setting up two-factor sign-in needs a recent sign-in, and yours is more than a few minutes old. Sign in again, and the setup goes on here.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.SignInAgainFailed
data.value: The sign-in server could not be reached, so you are still signed in as before. Try again in a moment.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.Changed
data.value: Two-factor sign-in was changed meanwhile, so nothing was done. Its status is shown again.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.ActionFailed
data.value: That did not work. The server did not answer, or answered with an error.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.CodesText
data.value: Each code signs you in once if you lose the app. Copy them somewhere safe now: they are shown only this once.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.CodesClosed
data.value: The recovery codes are no longer shown.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.DisableRequired
data.value: A role of yours requires two-factor sign-in, so the next sign-in asks you to set it up again.

data.name: Account.Logins.Explained
data.value: You can sign in with these providers. Removing one ends your sessions, so you sign in again at once.

data.name: Account.Logins.None
data.value: No external login is linked to your account.

data.name: Account.Logins.RemoveWhich
data.comment: Read after Remove by assistive technology only; {0} is the provider.

data.name: Account.Logins.LastWayIn
data.value: This login is your last way to sign in, so it stays. Link another provider or set a password first.

data.name: Account.Logins.RemoveFailed
data.value: The login could not be removed. Try again.

data.name: Account.Sessions.EndWhichStarted

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.KeyOnlyText
data.value: The address for the app, with the site's name in it, is too long for a QR code. Enter this key in the app by hand, then enter the code the app shows.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.CodesSignInAgain
data.value: Turning two-factor sign-in on ended your sessions: once you have saved the codes, you sign in again, with a code from the app.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.DisableSignInAgain
data.value: Turning it off ends your sessions, so you sign in again afterwards.

data.name: Account.TwoFactor.EnrolSignInAgain
data.value: Turning it on ends your sessions: after you have saved the recovery codes, you sign in again.
